enrichment method: The purified DNAs were biotinylated by using DNA Polymerase I, Large (Klenow) Fragment (NEB), and immobilized to Dynabeads M-280 Streptavidin (Thermo Fisher Scientific) for enriching the associated gene regulatory complexes from the HepG2 cell nuclear extracts.
labeling: A ratio (Low/High) between numbers of peptides detected at low glucose and numbers of peptides detected at high glucose was calculated and subjected to Log2(Low/High) analysis.
reduction reagent: binding buffer (10 mM Tris–HCl, pH = 7.5, 50 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM DTT, 10% glycerol, 0.5 µg poly (dI-dC), 0.05% NP-40)
reduction concentration: binding buffer (10 mM Tris–HCl, pH = 7.5, 50 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM DTT, 10% glycerol, 0.5 µg poly (dI-dC), 0.05% NP-40)
